rationale: Ground truth carries no substantive concerns (bot rate-limit notices, 'thanks for the fix'), so recall is trivially satisfied by both. Both candidates independently and correctly nail the flagship issue — the new regression test has no pytestmark and is silently deselected by the CI marker filter — with matching evidence and an identical fix. X goes deeper with well-grounded, actionable bugs invisible in the diff itself (warmup_quack_fp8() bypassing the gate entirely, warning_once failing to dedupe because it keys on the exception object, and the per-call retry loop amplifying any future failure), each with concrete patches and clear blocking/should-fix triage. Y's remaining findings (naming-rename confirmation, 'state the blast radius in the PR description', an AMD/NPU non-causation nit) are grounded but low-value padding that dilutes an otherwise good arch-exclusion catch (cc 11.x/sm_110a), making it less actionable overall than X's tightly prioritized report.
